items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I know Sam... I've known Sam for so many years... he plays damn well... he's a hard worker.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think I remember now. Let's see, I know Sam, and maybe -- whoof-foof-foof-foof.
I see, but wasn't Sam sort of organizing dates for Decca at that time?
